Ya'ni suraj benoor ho jayega, jata rahega, oondha kar ke lapet kar zameen par phenk diya jayega. Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) farmate hain suraj, chand aur sitaron ko lapet kar benoor kar ke samundaron mein daal diya jayega aur phir maghribi hawayein chalengi aur aag lag jayegi. Ek marfoo hadith mein hai ke is ko teh kar ke jahannam mein daal diya jayega (Ibn-e-Abi Hatim). Aur ek hadith mein suraj ke sath chand ka zikr bhi hai lekin woh za'eef hai. Sahih Bukhari mein yeh hadith alfaaz ki tabdeeli se marwi hai, is mein hai ke suraj aur chand qayamat ke din lapet liye jayenge. Imam Bukhari (R.H) ise Kitab-e-Bad-ul-Khalq mein laye hain lekin yahan lana zyada munasib tha ya mutabiq-e-aadat wahan aur yahan dono jagah late jaise ke Imam sahab ki aadat hai. Hazrat Abu Hurairah (R.A) ne jab yeh hadith bayan ki ke qayamat ke din yeh hoga, to Hazrat Hasan (R.H) kehne lage in ka kya gunah hai? Farmaya main ne hadith kahi aur tum is par baatein banate ho. Suraj ki qayamat wale din yeh halat hogi. Sitare sare mutaghayyar ho kar jhad jayenge jaise aur jagah hai aayat (Wa izal-kawakibu-ntatharat) (Surah Al-Infitar: 2). Yeh bhi gadle aur benoor ho kar bujh jayenge. Hazrat Ubayy bin Ka'ab (R.A) farmate hain qayamat se pehle chhe nishaniyan hongi, log apne bazaron mein honge ke achanak suraj ki roshni jati rahegi aur phir nagahan sitare toot toot kar girne lagenge, phir achanak pahad zameen par gir padenge aur zameen zor zor se jhatke lene lagegi aur betarah hilne lagegi. Bas phir kya insaan, kya jinnat, kya janwar aur kya jungli janwar sab aapas mein khalt-malt ho jayenge. Janwar bhi jo insanon se bhage phirte hain insanon ke paas aa jayenge. Logon ko is qadar bad-hawasi aur ghabrahat hogi ke behtar se behtar maal, oontiyan jo byahne waliyan hongi, un ki bhi khair-khabar na lenge. Jinnat kahenge ke hum jate hain ke tehqeeq karein kya ho raha hai lekin woh aayenge to dekhenge ke samundaron mein bhi aag lag rahi hai. Isi haal mein ek dam zameen phatne lagegi aur aasman bhi tootne lagenge, saaton zameenein aur saaton aasmanon ka yahi haal hoga. Udhar se ek tund hawa chalegi jis se tamam jaandar mar jayenge.

(Ibn-e-Abi Hatim waghera) ek aur riwayat mein hai Rasool Allah (ﷺ) farmate hain ke saare sitare aur jin jin ki Allah ke siwa ibadat ki gayi hai sab Jahannam mein gira diye jayenge, sirf Hazrat Isa (A.S) aur Hazrat Maryam (A.S) bach rahenge, agar yeh bhi apni ibadat se khush hote toh yeh bhi Jahannam mein dakhil kar diye jaate. (Ibn-e-Abi Hatim) Pahar apni jagah se tal jayenge aur benam-o-nishan ho jayenge, zameen chatyal aur hamwar maidan reh jayegi, untniyan bekar chhor di jayengi, na un ki koi nigrani karega na charaye chugaye ga na doodh nikale ga na sawari lega. 'Ushar' jama hai 'Ushra' ki, jo hamila untni daswein mahine mein lag jaye use 'Ushra' kehte hain. Matlab yeh hai ke ghabrahat aur bad-hawasi, bechaini aur pareshani is qadar hogi ke behtar se behtar maal ki bhi parwah na rahegi. Qayamat ki in balaon ne dil ura diya hoga, kaleje munh ko aayenge. Baaz log kehte hain ke yeh Qayamat ke din hoga aur logon ko is se kuch sarokar na hoga, haan un ke dekhne mein yeh hoga. Is qaul ke qail 'Ushar' ke kayi ma'ani bayan karte hain; ek toh yeh kehte hain is se murad badal hain jo duniya ki barbadi ki wajah se aasman-o-zameen ke darmiyan phirte phirenge, baaz kehte hain is se murad woh zameen hai jis ka ushar diya jata hai, baaz kehte hain is se murad ghar hain jo pehle abad the ab viran hain. Imam Qurtubi in aqwal ko bayan kar ke tarjeeh isi ko dete hain ke murad is se untniyan hain aur aksar mufassireen ka yahi qaul hai aur main toh yahi kehta hoon ke salaf se aur aimma se is ke siwa kuch warid hi nahin hua, Wallahu A'lam. Aur wahshi janwar jama kiye jayenge, jaise farman hai ayat (Wa ma min dabbatin fil-ardi wa la ta'irin yatiru bijanahihi illa umamun amthalukum) (6. Al-An'am: 38), yani zameen par chalne wale kul janwar aur hawa mein urne wale kul parind bhi tumhari tarah giroh hain, hum ne apni kitab mein koi cheez nahin chhori, phir yeh sab apne Rab ki taraf jama kiye jayenge. Sab jandaron ka hashr usi ke paas hoga yahan tak ke makkhiyan bhi, in sab mein Allah Ta'ala insaf ke sath faisle karega. In janwaron ka hashr un ki maut hi hai, albatta jin-o-ins Allah ke samne khare kiye jayenge aur un se hisab-kitab hoga. Rabi bin Khusaim ne kaha murad wahshiyon ke hashr se un par Allah ka amr aana hai, lekin Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) ne yeh sun kar farmaya ke is se murad maut hai. Yeh tamam janwar bhi ek dusre ke sath aur insanon ke sath ho jayenge, khud Quran mein aur jagah hai ayat (Wat-taira mahshurah, kullul lahu awwab) (38. Sad: 19), parind jama kiye hue, pas theek matlab is ayat ka bhi yahi hai ke wahshi janwar jama kiye jayenge. Hazrat Ali (R.A) ne ek Yahudi se poocha Jahannam kahan hai? Us ne kaha samundar mein, aap ne farmaya mere khayal mein yeh sacha hai, Quran kehta hai ayat (Wal-bahril masjur) (52. At-Tur: 6) aur farmata hai ayat (Wa izal-biharu sujjirat) (81. At-Takwir: 6).

(At-Takwir: 6) Ibn-e-Abbas R.A waghera farmate hain Allah Ta'ala maghribi hawayein bhejega woh isay bharka dengi aur sholay marti hui aag ban jayega. Ayat (Wa iza-l-biharu sujjirat) (81. At-Takwir: 6) ki tafsir mein is ka mufassal bayan guzar chuka hai. Hazrat Muawiyah bin Saeed R.H farmate hain bahr-e-room mein barkat hai, yeh zameen ke darmiyan mein hai, sab nahrein is mein girti hain aur bahr-e-kabeer bhi is mein parta hai, is ke neechay kunwein hain jin ke munh tanba se band kiye hue hain, qayam ke din woh sulag uthenge. Yeh asar ajeeb hai aur sath hi ghareeb bhi hai. Haan Abu Dawood mein ek hadith hai ke samundar ka safar sirf haaji karein aur umrah karne wale ya jihad karne wale ghazi, is liye ke samundar ke neechay aag hai aur aag ke neechay pani hai. Is ka bayan bhi Surah Fatir ki tafsir mein guzar chuka hai. Sujjirat ke ma'ani yeh bhi kiye gaye hain ke khushk kar diya jayega, ek qatra bhi baqi na rahega. Yeh ma'ani bhi kiye gaye hain ke baha diya jayega aur idhar udhar beh niklega. Phir farmata hai ke har qisam ke log yakja jama kar diye jayenge, jaise aur jagah hai ayat (Ushuru-l-lazina zalamu wa azwajahum wa ma kanu ya'budun) (37. As-Saffat: 22) zalimon ko aur un ke joron yani un jaison ko jama karo. Hadith mein hai har shakhs ka us qoum ke sath hashr kiya jayega jo is jaise a'maal karti ho. Allah Ta'ala farmata hai ayat (Wa kuntum azwajan salasa) (56. Al-Waqi'ah: 7) tum teen tarah ke giroh ho jaoge, kuch woh jin ke dahne hath mein namah-e-a'maal honge, kuch bayen hath wale, kuch sabqat karne wale. Ibn-e-Abi Hatim mein hai ke Hazrat Umar bin Khattab R.A ne khutba parhte hue is ayat ki tilawat ki aur farmaya har jama'at apne jaison se mil jayegi. Dusri riwayat mein hai ke woh do shakhs jin ke amal ek jaise hon woh ya to jannat mein sath rahenge ya jahannam mein sath jalenge. Hazrat Umar R.A se is ayat ki tafsir puchi gayi to farmaya nek nekon ke sath mil jayenge aur bad badon ke sath aag mein. Hazrat Farooq-e-Azam R.A ne ek martaba logon se is ayat ki tafsir puchi to sab khamosh rahe, aap ne farmaya lo main bataun, aadmi ka jora jannat mein isi jaisa hoga isi tarah jahannam mein bhi. Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas R.A farmate hain matlab is se yahi hai ke teen qisam ke log ho jayenge yani Ashab-e-Yameen, Ashab-e-Shimal aur Sabiqeen. Mujahid R.H farmate hain har qisam ke log ek sath honge, yahi qaul Imam Ibn-e-Jareer R.H bhi pasand karte hain aur yahi theek bhi hai. Dusra qaul yeh hai ke Arsh ke paas se pani ka ek darya jaari hoga jo chalis saal tak behta rahega aur bari numaya choran mein hoga, is se tamam mare saray galay ugnay lagenge, is tarah ke ho jayenge ke jo unhein pehchanta ho woh agar unhein ab dekh le to ba-yak nigah pehchan le, phir ruhein chhori jayengi aur har rooh apne jism mein aa jayegi, yahi ma'ani hain ayat (Wa iza-n-nufusu zuwwijat).

(At-Takwir: 7) Ya'ni roohein jismon mein mila di jayengi aur yeh ma'ni bhi bayan kiye gaye hain ke mominon ka jora hooron se lagaya jayega aur kafiron ka shaitanon se (Tazkirah Qurtubi). Phir irshad hota hai ayat (Wa izal-mau'udatu su'ilat) (81. At-Takwir: 8). Jamhoor ki qira'at yahi hai. Ahl-e-Jahiliyat ladkiyon ko napasand karte thay aur unhein zinda dargor (zinda dafan) kardiya karte thay. Un se Qayamat ke din sawal hoga ke yeh kyun qatl ki gayin? Taake un ke qatilon ko zyada daant-dupat aur sharmindagi ho aur yeh bhi samajh lijiye ke jab mazloom se sawal hua to zalim ka to kehna hi kya hai? Aur yeh bhi kaha gaya hai ke woh khud poochengi ke unhein kis bina par zinda dargor kiya gaya? Is ke mutaliq ahadees suniye. Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hai Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain: Main ne qasd kiya ke logon ko halat-e-hamal ki mujama'at se rok doon lekin main ne dekha ke Roomi aur Farsi yeh kaam karte hain aur un ki aulad ko is se kuch nuqsan nahin pahunchta. Logon ne aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se azl ke bare mein sawal kiya ya'ni bar-waqt nutfa ko bahar daal dene ke bare mein to aap ne farmaya ke yeh dar-parda zinda gaar dena hai aur isi ka bayan "Wa izal-mau'udatu" al-kh mein hai. Salma bin Yazeed aur un ke bhai sarkar-e-nabuwwat mein hazir ho kar sawal karte hain ke hamari maa ameer-zadi thin, woh sila-rehmi karti thin, mehman-nawazi karti thin aur bhi nek kaam bahut kuch karti thin lekin jahiliyat mein hi mar gayi hain to kya us ke yeh nek kaam use kuch nafa denge? Aap ne farmaya nahin. Unhon ne kaha ke us ne hamari ek behen ko zinda dafan kardiya hai kya woh bhi use kuch nafa degi? Aap ne farmaya zinda gaadi hui aur zinda gaadne wali jahannam mein hain, haan yeh aur baat hai ke woh Islam ko qabool karle (Musnad-e-Ahmad). Ibn-e-Abi Hatim mein hai zinda dafan karne wali aur jise dafan kiya hai dono jahannam mein hain. Ek Sahabiya (R.A) ke sawal par ke Jannat mein kaun jayega? Aap ne farmaya Nabi, shaheed, bachay aur zinda dargor ki hui. Yeh hadees mursal hai Hazrat Hasan se jise ba'az muhaddiseen ne qabooliyat ka martaba diya hai. Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas farmate hain ke mushrikon ke chhoti umar mein mare hue bachay jannati hain, jo unhein jahannami kahe woh jhoota hai. Allah Ta'ala farmata hai (Wa izal-mau'udatu su'ilat) (81. At-Takwir: 8) (Ibn-e-Abi Hatim). Qais bin Asim (R.A) sawal karte hain ke Ya Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) main ne jahiliyat ke zamane mein apni bachiyon ko zinda daba diya hai main kya karoon? Aap ne farmaya har ek ke badle ek ghulam azad karo. Unhon ne kaha Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ghulam wala to main hoon nahin albata mere paas oont hain. Farmaya har ek ke badle ek oont Allah ke naam par qurban karo (Abdur Razzaq). Doosri riwayat mein hai ke main ne barah-terah ladkiyan zinda dafan kardi hain. Aap ne farmaya un ki ginti ke mutabiq ghulam azad karo. Unhon ne kaha bahut behtar main yahi karoon ga. Doosre saal wahan ek sau oont le kar aaye aur kehne lage Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) yeh meri qaum ka sadqa hai jo is ke badle hai jo main ne musalmanon ke sath kiya.

Hazrat Ali (R.A) farmate hain hum un oonton ko le jate thay aur un ka qaisiya rakh chora tha. Phir irshad hai ke nama-e-aamal bantay jayenge kisi ke dahne hath mein aur kisi ke bayen hath mein, aye Ibn-e-Adam tu likhwa raha hai jo lapet kar phaila kar tujhe diya jayega dekh le ke kya likhwa ke laya hai. Aasman ghaseet liya jayega aur khench liya jayega aur sameet liya jayega aur barbad ho jayega. Jahannam bharkayi jayegi Allah ke ghazab aur Bani Adam ke gunahon se uski aag tez ho jayegi. Jannat jannatiyon ke paas aa jayegi. Jab yeh tamam kaam ho chukenge us waqt har shakhs jaan lega ke usne apni duniya ki zindagi mein kya kuch aamal kiye thay, woh sab amal uske samne majood honge. Jaise aur jagah hai aayat (Yauma tajidu kullu nafsim ma amilat min khairim muhdara) (Surah Aal-e-Imran: 30). Jis din har shakhs apne kiye hue aamal ko pa lega, nek hain to samne dekh lega aur bad hain to us din woh aarzoo karega ke kaash! Uske aur uske darmiyan bahut doori hoti. Aur jagah hai aayat (Yunabba-ul-insanu yauma-izin bima qaddama wa akhkhar) (Surah Al-Qiyamah: 13). Us din insaan ko uske tamam agle pichle aamal se tanbeeh ki jayegi. Hazrat Umar (R.A) is soorat ko sunte rahe aur isko sunte hi farmaya agli tamam baatein isi liye bayan hui thin.

Dusra qaul yeh hai ke Arsh ke paas se pani ka ek darya jaari hoga jo chalis saal tak behta rahega aur bari numaya choran mein hoga, is se tamam mare saray galay ugnay lagenge, is tarah ke ho jayenge ke jo unhein pehchanta ho woh agar unhein ab dekh le to ba-yak nigah pehchan le, phir ruhein chhori jayengi aur har rooh apne jism mein aa jayegi, yahi ma'ani hain ayat (Wa iza-n-nufusu zuwwijat).

(At-Takwir: 7) Ya'ni roohein jismon mein mila di jayengi aur yeh ma'ni bhi bayan kiye gaye hain ke mominon ka jora hooron se lagaya jayega aur kafiron ka shaitanon se (Tazkirah Qurtubi). Phir irshad hota hai ayat (Wa izal-mau'udatu su'ilat) (81. At-Takwir: 8). Jamhoor ki qira'at yahi hai. Ahl-e-Jahiliyat ladkiyon ko napasand karte thay aur unhein zinda dargor (zinda dafan) kardiya karte thay. Un se Qayamat ke din sawal hoga ke yeh kyun qatl ki gayin? Taake un ke qatilon ko zyada daant-dupat aur sharmindagi ho aur yeh bhi samajh lijiye ke jab mazloom se sawal hua to zalim ka to kehna hi kya hai? Aur yeh bhi kaha gaya hai ke woh khud poochengi ke unhein kis bina par zinda dargor kiya gaya? Is ke mutaliq ahadees suniye. Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hai Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain: Main ne qasd kiya ke logon ko halat-e-hamal ki mujama'at se rok doon lekin main ne dekha ke Roomi aur Farsi yeh kaam karte hain aur un ki aulad ko is se kuch nuqsan nahin pahunchta. Logon ne aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se azl ke bare mein sawal kiya ya'ni bar-waqt nutfa ko bahar daal dene ke bare mein to aap ne farmaya ke yeh dar-parda zinda gaar dena hai aur isi ka bayan "Wa izal-mau'udatu" al-kh mein hai. Salma bin Yazeed aur un ke bhai sarkar-e-nabuwwat mein hazir ho kar sawal karte hain ke hamari maa ameer-zadi thin, woh sila-rehmi karti thin, mehman-nawazi karti thin aur bhi nek kaam bahut kuch karti thin lekin jahiliyat mein hi mar gayi hain to kya us ke yeh nek kaam use kuch nafa denge? Aap ne farmaya nahin. Unhon ne kaha ke us ne hamari ek behen ko zinda dafan kardiya hai kya woh bhi use kuch nafa degi? Aap ne farmaya zinda gaadi hui aur zinda gaadne wali jahannam mein hain, haan yeh aur baat hai ke woh Islam ko qabool karle (Musnad-e-Ahmad). Ibn-e-Abi Hatim mein hai zinda dafan karne wali aur jise dafan kiya hai dono jahannam mein hain. Ek Sahabiya (R.A) ke sawal par ke Jannat mein kaun jayega? Aap ne farmaya Nabi, shaheed, bachay aur zinda dargor ki hui. Yeh hadees mursal hai Hazrat Hasan se jise ba'az muhaddiseen ne qabooliyat ka martaba diya hai. Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas farmate hain ke mushrikon ke chhoti umar mein mare hue bachay jannati hain, jo unhein jahannami kahe woh jhoota hai. Allah Ta'ala farmata hai (Wa izal-mau'udatu su'ilat) (81. At-Takwir: 8) (Ibn-e-Abi Hatim). Qais bin Asim (R.A) sawal karte hain ke Ya Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) main ne jahiliyat ke zamane mein apni bachiyon ko zinda daba diya hai main kya karoon? Aap ne farmaya har ek ke badle ek ghulam azad karo. Unhon ne kaha Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ghulam wala to main hoon nahin albata mere paas oont hain. Farmaya har ek ke badle ek oont Allah ke naam par qurban karo (Abdur Razzaq). Doosri riwayat mein hai ke main ne barah-terah ladkiyan zinda dafan kardi hain. Aap ne farmaya un ki ginti ke mutabiq ghulam azad karo. Unhon ne kaha bahut behtar main yahi karoon ga. Doosre saal wahan ek sau oont le kar aaye aur kehne lage Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) yeh meri qaum ka sadqa hai jo is ke badle hai jo main ne musalmanon ke sath kiya.

Hazrat Ali (R.A) farmate hain hum un oonton ko le jate thay aur un ka qaisiya rakh chora tha. Phir irshad hai ke nama-e-aamal bantay jayenge kisi ke dahne hath mein aur kisi ke bayen hath mein, aye Ibn-e-Adam tu likhwa raha hai jo lapet kar phaila kar tujhe diya jayega dekh le ke kya likhwa ke laya hai. Aasman ghaseet liya jayega aur khench liya jayega aur sameet liya jayega aur barbad ho jayega. Jahannam bharkayi jayegi Allah ke ghazab aur Bani Adam ke gunahon se uski aag tez ho jayegi. Jannat jannatiyon ke paas aa jayegi. Jab yeh tamam kaam ho chukenge us waqt har shakhs jaan lega ke usne apni duniya ki zindagi mein kya kuch aamal kiye thay, woh sab amal uske samne majood honge. Jaise aur jagah hai aayat (Yauma tajidu kullu nafsim ma amilat min khairim muhdara) (Surah Aal-e-Imran: 30). Jis din har shakhs apne kiye hue aamal ko pa lega, nek hain to samne dekh lega aur bad hain to us din woh aarzoo karega ke kaash! Uske aur uske darmiyan bahut doori hoti. Aur jagah hai aayat (Yunabba-ul-insanu yauma-izin bima qaddama wa akhkhar) (Surah Al-Qiyamah: 13). Us din insaan ko uske tamam agle pichle aamal se tanbeeh ki jayegi. Hazrat Umar (R.A) is soorat ko sunte rahe aur isko sunte hi farmaya agli tamam baatein isi liye bayan hui thin.

Ya'ni suraj benoor ho jayega, jata rahega, oondha kar ke lapet kar zameen par phenk diya jayega. Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) farmate hain suraj, chand aur sitaron ko lapet kar benoor kar ke samundaron mein daal diya jayega aur phir maghribi hawayein chalengi aur aag lag jayegi. Ek marfoo hadith mein hai ke is ko teh kar ke jahannam mein daal diya jayega (Ibn-e-Abi Hatim). Aur ek hadith mein suraj ke sath chand ka zikr bhi hai lekin woh za'eef hai. Sahih Bukhari mein yeh hadith alfaaz ki tabdeeli se marwi hai, is mein hai ke suraj aur chand qayamat ke din lapet liye jayenge. Imam Bukhari (R.H) ise Kitab-e-Bad-ul-Khalq mein laye hain lekin yahan lana zyada munasib tha ya mutabiq-e-aadat wahan aur yahan dono jagah late jaise ke Imam sahab ki aadat hai. Hazrat Abu Hurairah (R.A) ne jab yeh hadith bayan ki ke qayamat ke din yeh hoga, to Hazrat Hasan (R.H) kehne lage in ka kya gunah hai? Farmaya main ne hadith kahi aur tum is par baatein banate ho. Suraj ki qayamat wale din yeh halat hogi. Sitare sare mutaghayyar ho kar jhad jayenge jaise aur jagah hai aayat (Wa izal-kawakibu-ntatharat) (Surah Al-Infitar: 2). Yeh bhi gadle aur benoor ho kar bujh jayenge. Hazrat Ubayy bin Ka'ab (R.A) farmate hain qayamat se pehle chhe nishaniyan hongi, log apne bazaron mein honge ke achanak suraj ki roshni jati rahegi aur phir nagahan sitare toot toot kar girne lagenge, phir achanak pahad zameen par gir padenge aur zameen zor zor se jhatke lene lagegi aur betarah hilne lagegi. Bas phir kya insaan, kya jinnat, kya janwar aur kya jungli janwar sab aapas mein khalt-malt ho jayenge. Janwar bhi jo insanon se bhage phirte hain insanon ke paas aa jayenge. Logon ko is qadar bad-hawasi aur ghabrahat hogi ke behtar se behtar maal, oontiyan jo byahne waliyan hongi, un ki bhi khair-khabar na lenge. Jinnat kahenge ke hum jate hain ke tehqeeq karein kya ho raha hai lekin woh aayenge to dekhenge ke samundaron mein bhi aag lag rahi hai. Isi haal mein ek dam zameen phatne lagegi aur aasman bhi tootne lagenge, saaton zameenein aur saaton aasmanon ka yahi haal hoga. Udhar se ek tund hawa chalegi jis se tamam jaandar mar jayenge.

(Ibn-e-Abi Hatim waghera) ek aur riwayat mein hai Rasool Allah (ﷺ) farmate hain ke saare sitare aur jin jin ki Allah ke siwa ibadat ki gayi hai sab Jahannam mein gira diye jayenge, sirf Hazrat Isa (A.S) aur Hazrat Maryam (A.S) bach rahenge, agar yeh bhi apni ibadat se khush hote toh yeh bhi Jahannam mein dakhil kar diye jaate. (Ibn-e-Abi Hatim) Pahar apni jagah se tal jayenge aur benam-o-nishan ho jayenge, zameen chatyal aur hamwar maidan reh jayegi, untniyan bekar chhor di jayengi, na un ki koi nigrani karega na charaye chugaye ga na doodh nikale ga na sawari lega. 'Ushar' jama hai 'Ushra' ki, jo hamila untni daswein mahine mein lag jaye use 'Ushra' kehte hain. Matlab yeh hai ke ghabrahat aur bad-hawasi, bechaini aur pareshani is qadar hogi ke behtar se behtar maal ki bhi parwah na rahegi. Qayamat ki in balaon ne dil ura diya hoga, kaleje munh ko aayenge. Baaz log kehte hain ke yeh Qayamat ke din hoga aur logon ko is se kuch sarokar na hoga, haan un ke dekhne mein yeh hoga. Is qaul ke qail 'Ushar' ke kayi ma'ani bayan karte hain; ek toh yeh kehte hain is se murad badal hain jo duniya ki barbadi ki wajah se aasman-o-zameen ke darmiyan phirte phirenge, baaz kehte hain is se murad woh zameen hai jis ka ushar diya jata hai, baaz kehte hain is se murad ghar hain jo pehle abad the ab viran hain. Imam Qurtubi in aqwal ko bayan kar ke tarjeeh isi ko dete hain ke murad is se untniyan hain aur aksar mufassireen ka yahi qaul hai aur main toh yahi kehta hoon ke salaf se aur aimma se is ke siwa kuch warid hi nahin hua, Wallahu A'lam. Aur wahshi janwar jama kiye jayenge, jaise farman hai ayat (Wa ma min dabbatin fil-ardi wa la ta'irin yatiru bijanahihi illa umamun amthalukum) (6. Al-An'am: 38), yani zameen par chalne wale kul janwar aur hawa mein urne wale kul parind bhi tumhari tarah giroh hain, hum ne apni kitab mein koi cheez nahin chhori, phir yeh sab apne Rab ki taraf jama kiye jayenge. Sab jandaron ka hashr usi ke paas hoga yahan tak ke makkhiyan bhi, in sab mein Allah Ta'ala insaf ke sath faisle karega. In janwaron ka hashr un ki maut hi hai, albatta jin-o-ins Allah ke samne khare kiye jayenge aur un se hisab-kitab hoga. Rabi bin Khusaim ne kaha murad wahshiyon ke hashr se un par Allah ka amr aana hai, lekin Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) ne yeh sun kar farmaya ke is se murad maut hai. Yeh tamam janwar bhi ek dusre ke sath aur insanon ke sath ho jayenge, khud Quran mein aur jagah hai ayat (Wat-taira mahshurah, kullul lahu awwab) (38. Sad: 19), parind jama kiye hue, pas theek matlab is ayat ka bhi yahi hai ke wahshi janwar jama kiye jayenge. Hazrat Ali (R.A) ne ek Yahudi se poocha Jahannam kahan hai? Us ne kaha samundar mein, aap ne farmaya mere khayal mein yeh sacha hai, Quran kehta hai ayat (Wal-bahril masjur) (52. At-Tur: 6) aur farmata hai ayat (Wa izal-biharu sujjirat) (81. At-Takwir: 6).

(At-Takwir: 6) Ibn-e-Abbas R.A waghera farmate hain Allah Ta'ala maghribi hawayein bhejega woh isay bharka dengi aur sholay marti hui aag ban jayega. Ayat (Wa iza-l-biharu sujjirat) (81. At-Takwir: 6) ki tafsir mein is ka mufassal bayan guzar chuka hai. Hazrat Muawiyah bin Saeed R.H farmate hain bahr-e-room mein barkat hai, yeh zameen ke darmiyan mein hai, sab nahrein is mein girti hain aur bahr-e-kabeer bhi is mein parta hai, is ke neechay kunwein hain jin ke munh tanba se band kiye hue hain, qayam ke din woh sulag uthenge. Yeh asar ajeeb hai aur sath hi ghareeb bhi hai. Haan Abu Dawood mein ek hadith hai ke samundar ka safar sirf haaji karein aur umrah karne wale ya jihad karne wale ghazi, is liye ke samundar ke neechay aag hai aur aag ke neechay pani hai. Is ka bayan bhi Surah Fatir ki tafsir mein guzar chuka hai. Sujjirat ke ma'ani yeh bhi kiye gaye hain ke khushk kar diya jayega, ek qatra bhi baqi na rahega. Yeh ma'ani bhi kiye gaye hain ke baha diya jayega aur idhar udhar beh niklega. Phir farmata hai ke har qisam ke log yakja jama kar diye jayenge, jaise aur jagah hai ayat (Ushuru-l-lazina zalamu wa azwajahum wa ma kanu ya'budun) (37. As-Saffat: 22) zalimon ko aur un ke joron yani un jaison ko jama karo. Hadith mein hai har shakhs ka us qoum ke sath hashr kiya jayega jo is jaise a'maal karti ho. Allah Ta'ala farmata hai ayat (Wa kuntum azwajan salasa) (56. Al-Waqi'ah: 7) tum teen tarah ke giroh ho jaoge, kuch woh jin ke dahne hath mein namah-e-a'maal honge, kuch bayen hath wale, kuch sabqat karne wale. Ibn-e-Abi Hatim mein hai ke Hazrat Umar bin Khattab R.A ne khutba parhte hue is ayat ki tilawat ki aur farmaya har jama'at apne jaison se mil jayegi. Dusri riwayat mein hai ke woh do shakhs jin ke amal ek jaise hon woh ya to jannat mein sath rahenge ya jahannam mein sath jalenge. Hazrat Umar R.A se is ayat ki tafsir puchi gayi to farmaya nek nekon ke sath mil jayenge aur bad badon ke sath aag mein. Hazrat Farooq-e-Azam R.A ne ek martaba logon se is ayat ki tafsir puchi to sab khamosh rahe, aap ne farmaya lo main bataun, aadmi ka jora jannat mein isi jaisa hoga isi tarah jahannam mein bhi. (Ibn-e-Abi Hatim waghera) ek aur riwayat mein hai Rasool Allah (ﷺ) farmate hain ke saare sitare aur jin jin ki Allah ke siwa ibadat ki gayi hai sab Jahannam mein gira diye jayenge, sirf Hazrat Isa (A.S) aur Hazrat Maryam (A.S) bach rahenge, agar yeh bhi apni ibadat se khush hote toh yeh bhi Jahannam mein dakhil kar diye jaate. (Ibn-e-Abi Hatim) Pahar apni jagah se tal jayenge aur benam-o-nishan ho jayenge, zameen chatyal aur hamwar maidan reh jayegi, untniyan bekar chhor di jayengi, na un ki koi nigrani karega na charaye chugaye ga na doodh nikale ga na sawari lega. 'Ushar' jama hai 'Ushra' ki, jo hamila untni daswein mahine mein lag jaye use 'Ushra' kehte hain. Matlab yeh hai ke ghabrahat aur bad-hawasi, bechaini aur pareshani is qadar hogi ke behtar se behtar maal ki bhi parwah na rahegi. Qayamat ki in balaon ne dil ura diya hoga, kaleje munh ko aayenge. Baaz log kehte hain ke yeh Qayamat ke din hoga aur logon ko is se kuch sarokar na hoga, haan un ke dekhne mein yeh hoga. Is qaul ke qail 'Ushar' ke kayi ma'ani bayan karte hain; ek toh yeh kehte hain is se murad badal hain jo duniya ki barbadi ki wajah se aasman-o-zameen ke darmiyan phirte phirenge, baaz kehte hain is se murad woh zameen hai jis ka ushar diya jata hai, baaz kehte hain is se murad ghar hain jo pehle abad the ab viran hain. Imam Qurtubi in aqwal ko bayan kar ke tarjeeh isi ko dete hain ke murad is se untniyan hain aur aksar mufassireen ka yahi qaul hai aur main toh yahi kehta hoon ke salaf se aur aimma se is ke siwa kuch warid hi nahin hua, Wallahu A'lam. Aur wahshi janwar jama kiye jayenge, jaise farman hai ayat (Wa ma min dabbatin fil-ardi wa la ta'irin yatiru bijanahihi illa umamun amthalukum) (6. Al-An'am: 38), yani zameen par chalne wale kul janwar aur hawa mein urne wale kul parind bhi tumhari tarah giroh hain, hum ne apni kitab mein koi cheez nahin chhori, phir yeh sab apne Rab ki taraf jama kiye jayenge. Sab jandaron ka hashr usi ke paas hoga yahan tak ke makkhiyan bhi, in sab mein Allah Ta'ala insaf ke sath faisle karega. In janwaron ka hashr un ki maut hi hai, albatta jin-o-ins Allah ke samne khare kiye jayenge aur un se hisab-kitab hoga. Rabi bin Khusaim ne kaha murad wahshiyon ke hashr se un par Allah ka amr aana hai, lekin Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) ne yeh sun kar farmaya ke is se murad maut hai. Yeh tamam janwar bhi ek dusre ke sath aur insanon ke sath ho jayenge, khud Quran mein aur jagah hai ayat (Wat-taira mahshurah, kullul lahu awwab) (38. Sad: 19), parind jama kiye hue, pas theek matlab is ayat ka bhi yahi hai ke wahshi janwar jama kiye jayenge. Hazrat Ali (R.A) ne ek Yahudi se poocha Jahannam kahan hai? Us ne kaha samundar mein, aap ne farmaya mere khayal mein yeh sacha hai, Quran kehta hai ayat (Wal-bahril masjur) (52. At-Tur: 6) aur farmata hai ayat (Wa izal-biharu sujjirat) (81. At-Takwir: 6).

(At-Takwir: 6) Ibn-e-Abbas R.A waghera farmate hain Allah Ta'ala maghribi hawayein bhejega woh isay bharka dengi aur sholay marti hui aag ban jayega. Ayat (Wa iza-l-biharu sujjirat) (81. At-Takwir: 6) ki tafsir mein is ka mufassal bayan guzar chuka hai. Hazrat Muawiyah bin Saeed R.H farmate hain bahr-e-room mein barkat hai, yeh zameen ke darmiyan mein hai, sab nahrein is mein girti hain aur bahr-e-kabeer bhi is mein parta hai, is ke neechay kunwein hain jin ke munh tanba se band kiye hue hain, qayam ke din woh sulag uthenge. Yeh asar ajeeb hai aur sath hi ghareeb bhi hai. Haan Abu Dawood mein ek hadith hai ke samundar ka safar sirf haaji karein aur umrah karne wale ya jihad karne wale ghazi, is liye ke samundar ke neechay aag hai aur aag ke neechay pani hai. Is ka bayan bhi Surah Fatir ki tafsir mein guzar chuka hai. Sujjirat ke ma'ani yeh bhi kiye gaye hain ke khushk kar diya jayega, ek qatra bhi baqi na rahega. Yeh ma'ani bhi kiye gaye hain ke baha diya jayega aur idhar udhar beh niklega. Phir farmata hai ke har qisam ke log yakja jama kar diye jayenge, jaise aur jagah hai ayat (Ushuru-l-lazina zalamu wa azwajahum wa ma kanu ya'budun) (37. As-Saffat: 22) zalimon ko aur un ke joron yani un jaison ko jama karo. Hadith mein hai har shakhs ka us qoum ke sath hashr kiya jayega jo is jaise a'maal karti ho. Allah Ta'ala farmata hai ayat (Wa kuntum azwajan salasa) (56. Al-Waqi'ah: 7) tum teen tarah ke giroh ho jaoge, kuch woh jin ke dahne hath mein namah-e-a'maal honge, kuch bayen hath wale, kuch sabqat karne wale. Ibn-e-Abi Hatim mein hai ke Hazrat Umar bin Khattab R.A ne khutba parhte hue is ayat ki tilawat ki aur farmaya har jama'at apne jaison se mil jayegi. Dusri riwayat mein hai ke woh do shakhs jin ke amal ek jaise hon woh ya to jannat mein sath rahenge ya jahannam mein sath jalenge. Hazrat Umar R.A se is ayat ki tafsir puchi gayi to farmaya nek nekon ke sath mil jayenge aur bad badon ke sath aag mein. Hazrat Farooq-e-Azam R.A ne ek martaba logon se is ayat ki tafsir puchi to sab khamosh rahe, aap ne farmaya lo main bataun, aadmi ka jora jannat mein isi jaisa hoga isi tarah jahannam mein bhi. Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas R.A farmate hain matlab is se yahi hai ke teen qisam ke log ho jayenge yani Ashab-e-Yameen, Ashab-e-Shimal aur Sabiqeen. Mujahid R.H farmate hain har qisam ke log ek sath honge, yahi qaul Imam Ibn-e-Jareer R.H bhi pasand karte hain aur yahi theek bhi hai. Dusra qaul yeh hai ke Arsh ke paas se pani ka ek darya jaari hoga jo chalis saal tak behta rahega aur bari numaya choran mein hoga, is se tamam mare saray galay ugnay lagenge, is tarah ke ho jayenge ke jo unhein pehchanta ho woh agar unhein ab dekh le to ba-yak nigah pehchan le, phir ruhein chhori jayengi aur har rooh apne jism mein aa jayegi, yahi ma'ani hain ayat (Wa iza-n-nufusu zuwwijat).

(At-Takwir: 7) Ya'ni roohein jismon mein mila di jayengi aur yeh ma'ni bhi bayan kiye gaye hain ke mominon ka jora hooron se lagaya jayega aur kafiron ka shaitanon se (Tazkirah Qurtubi). Phir irshad hota hai ayat (Wa izal-mau'udatu su'ilat) (81. At-Takwir: 8). Jamhoor ki qira'at yahi hai. Ahl-e-Jahiliyat ladkiyon ko napasand karte thay aur unhein zinda dargor (zinda dafan) kardiya karte thay. Un se Qayamat ke din sawal hoga ke yeh kyun qatl ki gayin? Taake un ke qatilon ko zyada daant-dupat aur sharmindagi ho aur yeh bhi samajh lijiye ke jab mazloom se sawal hua to zalim ka to kehna hi kya hai? Aur yeh bhi kaha gaya hai ke woh khud poochengi ke unhein kis bina par zinda dargor kiya gaya? Is ke mutaliq ahadees suniye. Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hai Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain: Main ne qasd kiya ke logon ko halat-e-hamal ki mujama'at se rok doon lekin main ne dekha ke Roomi aur Farsi yeh kaam karte hain aur un ki aulad ko is se kuch nuqsan nahin pahunchta. Logon ne aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se azl ke bare mein sawal kiya ya'ni bar-waqt nutfa ko bahar daal dene ke bare mein to aap ne farmaya ke yeh dar-parda zinda gaar dena hai aur isi ka bayan "Wa izal-mau'udatu" al-kh mein hai. Salma bin Yazeed aur un ke bhai sarkar-e-nabuwwat mein hazir ho kar sawal karte hain ke hamari maa ameer-zadi thin, woh sila-rehmi karti thin, mehman-nawazi karti thin aur bhi nek kaam bahut kuch karti thin lekin jahiliyat mein hi mar gayi hain to kya us ke yeh nek kaam use kuch nafa denge? Aap ne farmaya nahin. Unhon ne kaha ke us ne hamari ek behen ko zinda dafan kardiya hai kya woh bhi use kuch nafa degi? Aap ne farmaya zinda gaadi hui aur zinda gaadne wali jahannam mein hain, haan yeh aur baat hai ke woh Islam ko qabool karle (Musnad-e-Ahmad). Ibn-e-Abi Hatim mein hai zinda dafan karne wali aur jise dafan kiya hai dono jahannam mein hain. Ek Sahabiya (R.A) ke sawal par ke Jannat mein kaun jayega? Aap ne farmaya Nabi, shaheed, bachay aur zinda dargor ki hui. Yeh hadees mursal hai Hazrat Hasan se jise ba'az muhaddiseen ne qabooliyat ka martaba diya hai. Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas farmate hain ke mushrikon ke chhoti umar mein mare hue bachay jannati hain, jo unhein jahannami kahe woh jhoota hai. Allah Ta'ala farmata hai (Wa izal-mau'udatu su'ilat) (81. At-Takwir: 8) (Ibn-e-Abi Hatim). Qais bin Asim (R.A) sawal karte hain ke Ya Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) main ne jahiliyat ke zamane mein apni bachiyon ko zinda daba diya hai main kya karoon? Aap ne farmaya har ek ke badle ek ghulam azad karo. Unhon ne kaha Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ghulam wala to main hoon nahin albata mere paas oont hain. Farmaya har ek ke badle ek oont Allah ke naam par qurban karo (Abdur Razzaq). Doosri riwayat mein hai ke main ne barah-terah ladkiyan zinda dafan kardi hain. Aap ne farmaya un ki ginti ke mutabiq ghulam azad karo. Unhon ne kaha bahut behtar main yahi karoon ga. Doosre saal wahan ek sau oont le kar aaye aur kehne lage Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) yeh meri qaum ka sadqa hai jo is ke badle hai jo main ne musalmanon ke sath kiya.

Hazrat Ali (R.A) farmate hain hum un oonton ko le jate thay aur un ka qaisiya rakh chora tha. Phir irshad hai ke nama-e-aamal bantay jayenge kisi ke dahne hath mein aur kisi ke bayen hath mein, aye Ibn-e-Adam tu likhwa raha hai jo lapet kar phaila kar tujhe diya jayega dekh le ke kya likhwa ke laya hai. Aasman ghaseet liya jayega aur khench liya jayega aur sameet liya jayega aur barbad ho jayega. Jahannam bharkayi jayegi Allah ke ghazab aur Bani Adam ke gunahon se uski aag tez ho jayegi. Jannat jannatiyon ke paas aa jayegi. Jab yeh tamam kaam ho chukenge us waqt har shakhs jaan lega ke usne apni duniya ki zindagi mein kya kuch aamal kiye thay, woh sab amal uske samne majood honge. Jaise aur jagah hai aayat (Yauma tajidu kullu nafsim ma amilat min khairim muhdara) (Surah Aal-e-Imran: 30). Jis din har shakhs apne kiye hue aamal ko pa lega, nek hain to samne dekh lega aur bad hain to us din woh aarzoo karega ke kaash! Uske aur uske darmiyan bahut doori hoti. Aur jagah hai aayat (Yunabba-ul-insanu yauma-izin bima qaddama wa akhkhar) (Surah Al-Qiyamah: 13). Us din insaan ko uske tamam agle pichle aamal se tanbeeh ki jayegi. Hazrat Umar (R.A) is soorat ko sunte rahe aur isko sunte hi farmaya agli tamam baatein isi liye bayan hui thin.

Ya'ni suraj benoor ho jayega, jata rahega, oondha kar ke lapet kar zameen par phenk diya jayega. Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) farmate hain suraj, chand aur sitaron ko lapet kar benoor kar ke samundaron mein daal diya jayega aur phir maghribi hawayein chalengi aur aag lag jayegi. Ek marfoo hadith mein hai ke is ko teh kar ke jahannam mein daal diya jayega (Ibn-e-Abi Hatim). Aur ek hadith mein suraj ke sath chand ka zikr bhi hai lekin woh za'eef hai. Sahih Bukhari mein yeh hadith alfaaz ki tabdeeli se marwi hai, is mein hai ke suraj aur chand qayamat ke din lapet liye jayenge. Imam Bukhari (R.H) ise Kitab-e-Bad-ul-Khalq mein laye hain lekin yahan lana zyada munasib tha ya mutabiq-e-aadat wahan aur yahan dono jagah late jaise ke Imam sahab ki aadat hai. Hazrat Abu Hurairah (R.A) ne jab yeh hadith bayan ki ke qayamat ke din yeh hoga, to Hazrat Hasan (R.H) kehne lage in ka kya gunah hai? Farmaya main ne hadith kahi aur tum is par baatein banate ho. Suraj ki qayamat wale din yeh halat hogi. Sitare sare mutaghayyar ho kar jhad jayenge jaise aur jagah hai aayat (Wa izal-kawakibu-ntatharat) (Surah Al-Infitar: 2). Yeh bhi gadle aur benoor ho kar bujh jayenge. Hazrat Ubayy bin Ka'ab (R.A) farmate hain qayamat se pehle chhe nishaniyan hongi, log apne bazaron mein honge ke achanak suraj ki roshni jati rahegi aur phir nagahan sitare toot toot kar girne lagenge, phir achanak pahad zameen par gir padenge aur zameen zor zor se jhatke lene lagegi aur betarah hilne lagegi. Bas phir kya insaan, kya jinnat, kya janwar aur kya jungli janwar sab aapas mein khalt-malt ho jayenge. Janwar bhi jo insanon se bhage phirte hain insanon ke paas aa jayenge. Salma bin Yazeed aur un ke bhai sarkar-e-nabuwwat mein hazir ho kar sawal karte hain ke hamari maa ameer-zadi thin, woh sila-rehmi karti thin, mehman-nawazi karti thin aur bhi nek kaam bahut kuch karti thin lekin jahiliyat mein hi mar gayi hain to kya us ke yeh nek kaam use kuch nafa denge? Aap ne farmaya nahin. Unhon ne kaha ke us ne hamari ek behen ko zinda dafan kardiya hai kya woh bhi use kuch nafa degi? Aap ne farmaya zinda gaadi hui aur zinda gaadne wali jahannam mein hain, haan yeh aur baat hai ke woh Islam ko qabool karle (Musnad-e-Ahmad). Ibn-e-Abi Hatim mein hai zinda dafan karne wali aur jise dafan kiya hai dono jahannam mein hain. Ek Sahabiya (R.A) ke sawal par ke Jannat mein kaun jayega? Aap ne farmaya Nabi, shaheed, bachay aur zinda dargor ki hui. Yeh hadees mursal hai Hazrat Hasan se jise ba'az muhaddiseen ne qabooliyat ka martaba diya hai. Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas farmate hain ke mushrikon ke chhoti umar mein mare hue bachay jannati hain, jo unhein jahannami kahe woh jhoota hai. Allah Ta'ala farmata hai (Wa izal-mau'udatu su'ilat) (81. At-Takwir: 8) (Ibn-e-Abi Hatim). Qais bin Asim (R.A) sawal karte hain ke Ya Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) main ne jahiliyat ke zamane mein apni bachiyon ko zinda daba diya hai main kya karoon? Aap ne farmaya har ek ke badle ek ghulam azad karo. Unhon ne kaha Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ghulam wala to main hoon nahin albata mere paas oont hain. Farmaya har ek ke badle ek oont Allah ke naam par qurban karo (Abdur Razzaq). Doosri riwayat mein hai ke main ne barah-terah ladkiyan zinda dafan kardi hain. Aap ne farmaya un ki ginti ke mutabiq ghulam azad karo. Unhon ne kaha bahut behtar main yahi karoon ga. Doosre saal wahan ek sau oont le kar aaye aur kehne lage Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) yeh meri qaum ka sadqa hai jo is ke badle hai jo main ne musalmanon ke sath kiya.

Hazrat Ali (R.A) farmate hain hum un oonton ko le jate thay aur un ka qaisiya rakh chora tha. Phir irshad hai ke nama-e-aamal bantay jayenge kisi ke dahne hath mein aur kisi ke bayen hath mein, aye Ibn-e-Adam tu likhwa raha hai jo lapet kar phaila kar tujhe diya jayega dekh le ke kya likhwa ke laya hai. Aasman ghaseet liya jayega aur khench liya jayega aur sameet liya jayega aur barbad ho jayega. Jahannam bharkayi jayegi Allah ke ghazab aur Bani Adam ke gunahon se uski aag tez ho jayegi. Jannat jannatiyon ke paas aa jayegi. Jab yeh tamam kaam ho chukenge us waqt har shakhs jaan lega ke usne apni duniya ki zindagi mein kya kuch aamal kiye thay, woh sab amal uske samne majood honge. Jaise aur jagah hai aayat (Yauma tajidu kullu nafsim ma amilat min khairim muhdara) (Surah Aal-e-Imran: 30). Jis din har shakhs apne kiye hue aamal ko pa lega, nek hain to samne dekh lega aur bad hain to us din woh aarzoo karega ke kaash! Uske aur uske darmiyan bahut doori hoti. Aur jagah hai aayat (Yunabba-ul-insanu yauma-izin bima qaddama wa akhkhar) (Surah Al-Qiyamah: 13). Us din insaan ko uske tamam agle pichle aamal se tanbeeh ki jayegi. Hazrat Umar (R.A) is soorat ko sunte rahe aur isko sunte hi farmaya agli tamam baatein isi liye bayan hui thin.

Ya'ni suraj benoor ho jayega, jata rahega, oondha kar ke lapet kar zameen par phenk diya jayega. Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) farmate hain suraj, chand aur sitaron ko lapet kar benoor kar ke samundaron mein daal diya jayega aur phir maghribi hawayein chalengi aur aag lag jayegi. Ek marfoo hadith mein hai ke is ko teh kar ke jahannam mein daal diya jayega (Ibn-e-Abi Hatim). Aur ek hadith mein suraj ke sath chand ka zikr bhi hai lekin woh za'eef hai. Sahih Bukhari mein yeh hadith alfaaz ki tabdeeli se marwi hai, is mein hai ke suraj aur chand qayamat ke din lapet liye jayenge. Imam Bukhari (R.H) ise Kitab-e-Bad-ul-Khalq mein laye hain lekin yahan lana zyada munasib tha ya mutabiq-e-aadat wahan aur yahan dono jagah late jaise ke Imam sahab ki aadat hai. Hazrat Abu Hurairah (R.A) ne jab yeh hadith bayan ki ke qayamat ke din yeh hoga, to Hazrat Hasan (R.H) kehne lage in ka kya gunah hai? Farmaya main ne hadith kahi aur tum is par baatein banate ho. Suraj ki qayamat wale din yeh halat hogi. Sitare sare mutaghayyar ho kar jhad jayenge jaise aur jagah hai aayat (Wa izal-kawakibu-ntatharat) (Surah Al-Infitar: 2). Yeh bhi gadle aur benoor ho kar bujh jayenge. Hazrat Ubayy bin Ka'ab (R.A) farmate hain qayamat se pehle chhe nishaniyan hongi, log apne bazaron mein honge ke achanak suraj ki roshni jati rahegi aur phir nagahan sitare toot toot kar girne lagenge, phir achanak pahad zameen par gir padenge aur zameen zor zor se jhatke lene lagegi aur betarah hilne lagegi. Bas phir kya insaan, kya jinnat, kya janwar aur kya jungli janwar sab aapas mein khalt-malt ho jayenge. Janwar bhi jo insanon se bhage phirte hain insanon ke paas aa jayenge. Logon ko is qadar bad-hawasi aur ghabrahat hogi ke behtar se behtar maal, oontiyan jo byahne waliyan hongi, un ki bhi khair-khabar na lenge. Jinnat kahenge ke hum jate hain ke tehqeeq karein kya ho raha hai lekin woh aayenge to dekhenge ke samundaron mein bhi aag lag rahi hai. Isi haal mein ek dam zameen phatne lagegi aur aasman bhi tootne lagenge, saaton zameenein aur saaton aasmanon ka yahi haal hoga. Udhar se ek tund hawa chalegi jis se tamam jaandar mar jayenge.

(Ibn-e-Abi Hatim waghera) ek aur riwayat mein hai Rasool Allah (ﷺ) farmate hain ke saare sitare aur jin jin ki Allah ke siwa ibadat ki gayi hai sab Jahannam mein gira diye jayenge, sirf Hazrat Isa (A.S) aur Hazrat Maryam (A.S) bach rahenge, agar yeh bhi apni ibadat se khush hote toh yeh bhi Jahannam mein dakhil kar diye jaate. (Ibn-e-Abi Hatim) Pahar apni jagah se tal jayenge aur benam-o-nishan ho jayenge, zameen chatyal aur hamwar maidan reh jayegi, untniyan bekar chhor di jayengi, na un ki koi nigrani karega na charaye chugaye ga na doodh nikale ga na sawari lega. 'Ushar' jama hai 'Ushra' ki, jo hamila untni daswein mahine mein lag jaye use 'Ushra' kehte hain. Matlab yeh hai ke ghabrahat aur bad-hawasi, bechaini aur pareshani is qadar hogi ke behtar se behtar maal ki bhi parwah na rahegi. Qayamat ki in balaon ne dil ura diya hoga, kaleje munh ko aayenge. Baaz log kehte hain ke yeh Qayamat ke din hoga aur logon ko is se kuch sarokar na hoga, haan un ke dekhne mein yeh hoga. Is qaul ke qail 'Ushar' ke kayi ma'ani bayan karte hain; ek toh yeh kehte hain is se murad badal hain jo duniya ki barbadi ki wajah se aasman-o-zameen ke darmiyan phirte phirenge, baaz kehte hain is se murad woh zameen hai jis ka ushar diya jata hai, baaz kehte hain is se murad ghar hain jo pehle abad the ab viran hain. Imam Qurtubi in aqwal ko bayan kar ke tarjeeh isi ko dete hain ke murad is se untniyan hain aur aksar mufassireen ka yahi qaul hai aur main toh yahi kehta hoon ke salaf se aur aimma se is ke siwa kuch warid hi nahin hua, Wallahu A'lam. Aur wahshi janwar jama kiye jayenge, jaise farman hai ayat (Wa ma min dabbatin fil-ardi wa la ta'irin yatiru bijanahihi illa umamun amthalukum) (6. Al-An'am: 38), yani zameen par chalne wale kul janwar aur hawa mein urne wale kul parind bhi tumhari tarah giroh hain, hum ne apni kitab mein koi cheez nahin chhori, phir yeh sab apne Rab ki taraf jama kiye jayenge. Sab jandaron ka hashr usi ke paas hoga yahan tak ke makkhiyan bhi, in sab mein Allah Ta'ala insaf ke sath faisle karega. In janwaron ka hashr un ki maut hi hai, albatta jin-o-ins Allah ke samne khare kiye jayenge aur un se hisab-kitab hoga. Rabi bin Khusaim ne kaha murad wahshiyon ke hashr se un par Allah ka amr aana hai, lekin Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) ne yeh sun kar farmaya ke is se murad maut hai. Yeh tamam janwar bhi ek dusre ke sath aur insanon ke sath ho jayenge, khud Quran mein aur jagah hai ayat (Wat-taira mahshurah, kullul lahu awwab) (38. Sad: 19), parind jama kiye hue, pas theek matlab is ayat ka bhi yahi hai ke wahshi janwar jama kiye jayenge. Hazrat Ali (R.A) ne ek Yahudi se poocha Jahannam kahan hai? Us ne kaha samundar mein, aap ne farmaya mere khayal mein yeh sacha hai, Quran kehta hai ayat (Wal-bahril masjur) (52. At-Tur: 6) aur farmata hai ayat (Wa izal-biharu sujjirat) (81. At-Takwir: 6).

(At-Takwir: 6) Ibn-e-Abbas R.A waghera farmate hain Allah Ta'ala maghribi hawayein bhejega woh isay bharka dengi aur sholay marti hui aag ban jayega. Ayat (Wa iza-l-biharu sujjirat) (81. At-Takwir: 6) ki tafsir mein is ka mufassal bayan guzar chuka hai. Hazrat Muawiyah bin Saeed R.H farmate hain bahr-e-room mein barkat hai, yeh zameen ke darmiyan mein hai, sab nahrein is mein girti hain aur bahr-e-kabeer bhi is mein parta hai, is ke neechay kunwein hain jin ke munh tanba se band kiye hue hain, qayam ke din woh sulag uthenge. Yeh asar ajeeb hai aur sath hi ghareeb bhi hai. Haan Abu Dawood mein ek hadith hai ke samundar ka safar sirf haaji karein aur umrah karne wale ya jihad karne wale ghazi, is liye ke samundar ke neechay aag hai aur aag ke neechay pani hai. Is ka bayan bhi Surah Fatir ki tafsir mein guzar chuka hai. Sujjirat ke ma'ani yeh bhi kiye gaye hain ke khushk kar diya jayega, ek qatra bhi baqi na rahega. Yeh ma'ani bhi kiye gaye hain ke baha diya jayega aur idhar udhar beh niklega. Phir farmata hai ke har qisam ke log yakja jama kar diye jayenge, jaise aur jagah hai ayat (Ushuru-l-lazina zalamu wa azwajahum wa ma kanu ya'budun) (37. As-Saffat: 22) zalimon ko aur un ke joron yani un jaison ko jama karo. Hadith mein hai har shakhs ka us qoum ke sath hashr kiya jayega jo is jaise a'maal karti ho. Allah Ta'ala farmata hai ayat (Wa kuntum azwajan salasa) (56. Al-Waqi'ah: 7) tum teen tarah ke giroh ho jaoge, kuch woh jin ke dahne hath mein namah-e-a'maal honge, kuch bayen hath wale, kuch sabqat karne wale. Ibn-e-Abi Hatim mein hai ke Hazrat Umar bin Khattab R.A ne khutba parhte hue is ayat ki tilawat ki aur farmaya har jama'at apne jaison se mil jayegi. Dusri riwayat mein hai ke woh do shakhs jin ke amal ek jaise hon woh ya to jannat mein sath rahenge ya jahannam mein sath jalenge. Hazrat Umar R.A se is ayat ki tafsir puchi gayi to farmaya nek nekon ke sath mil jayenge aur bad badon ke sath aag mein. Hazrat Farooq-e-Azam R.A ne ek martaba logon se is ayat ki tafsir puchi to sab khamosh rahe, aap ne farmaya lo main bataun, aadmi ka jora jannat mein isi jaisa hoga isi tarah jahannam mein bhi. Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas R.A farmate hain matlab is se yahi hai ke teen qisam ke log ho jayenge yani Ashab-e-Yameen, Ashab-e-Shimal aur Sabiqeen. Mujahid R.H farmate hain har qisam ke log ek sath honge, yahi qaul Imam Ibn-e-Jareer R.H bhi pasand karte hain aur yahi theek bhi hai. Dusra qaul yeh hai ke Arsh ke paas se pani ka ek darya jaari hoga jo chalis saal tak behta rahega aur bari numaya choran mein hoga, is se tamam mare saray galay ugnay lagenge, is tarah ke ho jayenge ke jo unhein pehchanta ho woh agar unhein ab dekh le to ba-yak nigah pehchan le, phir ruhein chhori jayengi aur har rooh apne jism mein aa jayegi, yahi ma'ani hain ayat (Wa iza-n-nufusu zuwwijat).

(At-Takwir: 7) Ya'ni roohein jismon mein mila di jayengi aur yeh ma'ni bhi bayan kiye gaye hain ke mominon ka jora hooron se lagaya jayega aur kafiron ka shaitanon se (Tazkirah Qurtubi). Phir irshad hota hai ayat (Wa izal-mau'udatu su'ilat) (81. At-Takwir: 8). Jamhoor ki qira'at yahi hai. Taake un ke qatilon ko zyada daant-dupat aur sharmindagi ho aur yeh bhi samajh lijiye ke jab mazloom se sawal hua to zalim ka to kehna hi kya hai? Aur yeh bhi kaha gaya hai ke woh khud poochengi ke unhein kis bina par zinda dargor kiya gaya? Is ke mutaliq ahadees suniye. Al-An'am: 38), yani zameen par chalne wale kul janwar aur hawa mein urne wale kul parind bhi tumhari tarah giroh hain, hum ne apni kitab mein koi cheez nahin chhori, phir yeh sab apne Rab ki taraf jama kiye jayenge. Sab jandaron ka hashr usi ke paas hoga yahan tak ke makkhiyan bhi, in sab mein Allah Ta'ala insaf ke sath faisle karega. In janwaron ka hashr un ki maut hi hai, albatta jin-o-ins Allah ke samne khare kiye jayenge aur un se hisab-kitab hoga. Rabi bin Khusaim ne kaha murad wahshiyon ke hashr se un par Allah ka amr aana hai, lekin Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) ne yeh sun kar farmaya ke is se murad maut hai. Yeh tamam janwar bhi ek dusre ke sath aur insanon ke sath ho jayenge, khud Quran mein aur jagah hai ayat (Wat-taira mahshurah, kullul lahu awwab) (38. Sad: 19), parind jama kiye hue, pas theek matlab is ayat ka bhi yahi hai ke wahshi janwar jama kiye jayenge. Hazrat Ali (R.A) ne ek Yahudi se poocha Jahannam kahan hai? Us ne kaha samundar mein, aap ne farmaya mere khayal mein yeh sacha hai, Quran kehta hai ayat (Wal-bahril masjur) (52. At-Tur: 6) aur farmata hai ayat (Wa izal-biharu sujjirat) (81. At-Takwir: 6).

(At-Takwir: 6) Ibn-e-Abbas R.A waghera farmate hain Allah Ta'ala maghribi hawayein bhejega woh isay bharka dengi aur sholay marti hui aag ban jayega. Ayat (Wa iza-l-biharu sujjirat) (81. At-Takwir: 6) ki tafsir mein is ka mufassal bayan guzar chuka hai. Hazrat Muawiyah bin Saeed R.H farmate hain bahr-e-room mein barkat hai, yeh zameen ke darmiyan mein hai, sab nahrein is mein girti hain aur bahr-e-kabeer bhi is mein parta hai, is ke neechay kunwein hain jin ke munh tanba se band kiye hue hain, qayam ke din woh sulag uthenge. Yeh asar ajeeb hai aur sath hi ghareeb bhi hai. Haan Abu Dawood mein ek hadith hai ke samundar ka safar sirf haaji karein aur umrah karne wale ya jihad karne wale ghazi, is liye ke samundar ke neechay aag hai aur aag ke neechay pani hai. Is ka bayan bhi Surah Fatir ki tafsir mein guzar chuka hai. Sujjirat ke ma'ani yeh bhi kiye gaye hain ke khushk kar diya jayega, ek qatra bhi baqi na rahega. Yeh ma'ani bhi kiye gaye hain ke baha diya jayega aur idhar udhar beh niklega. Phir farmata hai ke har qisam ke log yakja jama kar diye jayenge, jaise aur jagah hai ayat (Ushuru-l-lazina zalamu wa azwajahum wa ma kanu ya'budun) (37. As-Saffat: 22) zalimon ko aur un ke joron yani un jaison ko jama karo. Hadith mein hai har shakhs ka us qoum ke sath hashr kiya jayega jo is jaise a'maal karti ho. Allah Ta'ala farmata hai ayat (Wa kuntum azwajan salasa) (56. Al-Waqi'ah: 7) tum teen tarah ke giroh ho jaoge, kuch woh jin ke dahne hath mein namah-e-a'maal honge, kuch bayen hath wale, kuch sabqat karne wale. Ibn-e-Abi Hatim mein hai ke Hazrat Umar bin Khattab R.A ne khutba parhte hue is ayat ki tilawat ki aur farmaya har jama'at apne jaison se mil jayegi. Dusri riwayat mein hai ke woh do shakhs jin ke amal ek jaise hon woh ya to jannat mein sath rahenge ya jahannam mein sath jalenge. Hazrat Umar R.A se is ayat ki tafsir puchi gayi to farmaya nek nekon ke sath mil jayenge aur bad badon ke sath aag mein. Hazrat Farooq-e-Azam R.A ne ek martaba logon se is ayat ki tafsir puchi to sab khamosh rahe, aap ne farmaya lo main bataun, aadmi ka jora jannat mein isi jaisa hoga isi tarah jahannam mein bhi. Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas R.A farmate hain matlab is se yahi hai ke teen qisam ke log ho jayenge yani Ashab-e-Yameen, Ashab-e-Shimal aur Sabiqeen. Mujahid R.H farmate hain har qisam ke log ek sath honge, yahi qaul Imam Ibn-e-Jareer R.H bhi pasand karte hain aur yahi theek bhi hai. Dusra qaul yeh hai ke Arsh ke paas se pani ka ek darya jaari hoga jo chalis saal tak behta rahega aur bari numaya choran mein hoga, is se tamam mare saray galay ugnay lagenge, is tarah ke ho jayenge ke jo unhein pehchanta ho woh agar unhein ab dekh le to ba-yak nigah pehchan le, phir ruhein chhori jayengi aur har rooh apne jism mein aa jayegi, yahi ma'ani hain ayat (Wa iza-n-nufusu zuwwijat).

(At-Takwir: 7) Ya'ni roohein jismon mein mila di jayengi aur yeh ma'ni bhi bayan kiye gaye hain ke mominon ka jora hooron se lagaya jayega aur kafiron ka shaitanon se (Tazkirah Qurtubi). Phir irshad hota hai ayat (Wa izal-mau'udatu su'ilat) (81. At-Takwir: 8). Jamhoor ki qira'at yahi hai. Ahl-e-Jahiliyat ladkiyon ko napasand karte thay aur unhein zinda dargor (zinda dafan) kardiya karte thay. Un se Qayamat ke din sawal hoga ke yeh kyun qatl ki gayin? Taake un ke qatilon ko zyada daant-dupat aur sharmindagi ho aur yeh bhi samajh lijiye ke jab mazloom se sawal hua to zalim ka to kehna hi kya hai? Aur yeh bhi kaha gaya hai ke woh khud poochengi ke unhein kis bina par zinda dargor kiya gaya? Is ke mutaliq ahadees suniye. Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hai Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain: Main ne qasd kiya ke logon ko halat-e-hamal ki mujama'at se rok doon lekin main ne dekha ke Roomi aur Farsi yeh kaam karte hain aur un ki aulad ko is se kuch nuqsan nahin pahunchta. Logon ne aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se azl ke bare mein sawal kiya ya'ni bar-waqt nutfa ko bahar daal dene ke bare mein to aap ne farmaya ke yeh dar-parda zinda gaar dena hai aur isi ka bayan "Wa izal-mau'udatu" al-kh mein hai. Salma bin Yazeed aur un ke bhai sarkar-e-nabuwwat mein hazir ho kar sawal karte hain ke hamari maa ameer-zadi thin, woh sila-rehmi karti thin, mehman-nawazi karti thin aur bhi nek kaam bahut kuch karti thin lekin jahiliyat mein hi mar gayi hain to kya us ke yeh nek kaam use kuch nafa denge? Aap ne farmaya nahin. Unhon ne kaha ke us ne hamari ek behen ko zinda dafan kardiya hai kya woh bhi use kuch nafa degi? Aap ne farmaya zinda gaadi hui aur zinda gaadne wali jahannam mein hain, haan yeh aur baat hai ke woh Islam ko qabool karle (Musnad-e-Ahmad). Ibn-e-Abi Hatim mein hai zinda dafan karne wali aur jise dafan kiya hai dono jahannam mein hain. Ek Sahabiya (R.A) ke sawal par ke Jannat mein kaun jayega? Aap ne farmaya Nabi, shaheed, bachay aur zinda dargor ki hui. Yeh hadees mursal hai Hazrat Hasan se jise ba'az muhaddiseen ne qabooliyat ka martaba diya hai. Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas farmate hain ke mushrikon ke chhoti umar mein mare hue bachay jannati hain, jo unhein jahannami kahe woh jhoota hai. Allah Ta'ala farmata hai (Wa izal-mau'udatu su'ilat) (81. At-Takwir: 8) (Ibn-e-Abi Hatim). Qais bin Asim (R.A) sawal karte hain ke Ya Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) main ne jahiliyat ke zamane mein apni bachiyon ko zinda daba diya hai main kya karoon? Aap ne farmaya har ek ke badle ek ghulam azad karo. Unhon ne kaha Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ghulam wala to main hoon nahin albata mere paas oont hain. Farmaya har ek ke badle ek oont Allah ke naam par qurban karo (Abdur Razzaq). Doosri riwayat mein hai ke main ne barah-terah ladkiyan zinda dafan kardi hain. Aap ne farmaya un ki ginti ke mutabiq ghulam azad karo. Unhon ne kaha bahut behtar main yahi karoon ga. Doosre saal wahan ek sau oont le kar aaye aur kehne lage Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) yeh meri qaum ka sadqa hai jo is ke badle hai jo main ne musalmanon ke sath kiya.

Hazrat Ali (R.A) farmate hain hum un oonton ko le jate thay aur un ka qaisiya rakh chora tha. Phir irshad hai ke nama-e-aamal bantay jayenge kisi ke dahne hath mein aur kisi ke bayen hath mein, aye Ibn-e-Adam tu likhwa raha hai jo lapet kar phaila kar tujhe diya jayega dekh le ke kya likhwa ke laya hai. Aasman ghaseet liya jayega aur khench liya jayega aur sameet liya jayega aur barbad ho jayega. Jahannam bharkayi jayegi Allah ke ghazab aur Bani Adam ke gunahon se uski aag tez ho jayegi. Jannat jannatiyon ke paas aa jayegi. Jab yeh tamam kaam ho chukenge us waqt har shakhs jaan lega ke usne apni duniya ki zindagi mein kya kuch aamal kiye thay, woh sab amal uske samne majood honge. Jaise aur jagah hai aayat (Yauma tajidu kullu nafsim ma amilat min khairim muhdara) (Surah Aal-e-Imran: 30). Jis din har shakhs apne kiye hue aamal ko pa lega, nek hain to samne dekh lega aur bad hain to us din woh aarzoo karega ke kaash! Uske aur uske darmiyan bahut doori hoti. Aur jagah hai aayat (Yunabba-ul-insanu yauma-izin bima qaddama wa akhkhar) (Surah Al-Qiyamah: 13). Us din insaan ko uske tamam agle pichle aamal se tanbeeh ki jayegi. Hazrat Umar (R.A) is soorat ko sunte rahe aur isko sunte hi farmaya agli tamam baatein isi liye bayan hui thin.

Ya'ni suraj benoor ho jayega, jata rahega, oondha kar ke lapet kar zameen par phenk diya jayega. Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) farmate hain suraj, chand aur sitaron ko lapet kar benoor kar ke samundaron mein daal diya jayega aur phir maghribi hawayein chalengi aur aag lag jayegi. Ek marfoo hadith mein hai ke is ko teh kar ke jahannam mein daal diya jayega (Ibn-e-Abi Hatim). Aur ek hadith mein suraj ke sath chand ka zikr bhi hai lekin woh za'eef hai. Sahih Bukhari mein yeh hadith alfaaz ki tabdeeli se marwi hai, is mein hai ke suraj aur chand qayamat ke din lapet liye jayenge. Imam Bukhari (R.H) ise Kitab-e-Bad-ul-Khalq mein laye hain lekin yahan lana zyada munasib tha ya mutabiq-e-aadat wahan aur yahan dono jagah late jaise ke Imam sahab ki aadat hai. Hazrat Abu Hurairah (R.A) ne jab yeh hadith bayan ki ke qayamat ke din yeh hoga, to Hazrat Hasan (R.H) kehne lage in ka kya gunah hai? Farmaya main ne hadith kahi aur tum is par baatein banate ho. Suraj ki qayamat wale din yeh halat hogi. Sitare sare mutaghayyar ho kar jhad jayenge jaise aur jagah hai aayat (Wa izal-kawakibu-ntatharat) (Surah Al-Infitar: 2). Yeh bhi gadle aur benoor ho kar bujh jayenge. Hazrat Ubayy bin Ka'ab (R.A) farmate hain qayamat se pehle chhe nishaniyan hongi, log apne bazaron mein honge ke achanak suraj ki roshni jati rahegi aur phir nagahan sitare toot toot kar girne lagenge, phir achanak pahad zameen par gir padenge aur zameen zor zor se jhatke lene lagegi aur betarah hilne lagegi. Bas phir kya insaan, kya jinnat, kya janwar aur kya jungli janwar sab aapas mein khalt-malt ho jayenge. Janwar bhi jo insanon se bhage phirte hain insanon ke paas aa jayenge. Logon ko is qadar bad-hawasi aur ghabrahat hogi ke behtar se behtar maal, oontiyan jo byahne waliyan hongi, un ki bhi khair-khabar na lenge. Jinnat kahenge ke hum jate hain ke tehqeeq karein kya ho raha hai lekin woh aayenge to dekhenge ke samundaron mein bhi aag lag rahi hai. Isi haal mein ek dam zameen phatne lagegi aur aasman bhi tootne lagenge, saaton zameenein aur saaton aasmanon ka yahi haal hoga. Udhar se ek tund hawa chalegi jis se tamam jaandar mar jayenge.

(Ibn-e-Abi Hatim waghera) ek aur riwayat mein hai Rasool Allah (ﷺ) farmate hain ke saare sitare aur jin jin ki Allah ke siwa ibadat ki gayi hai sab Jahannam mein gira diye jayenge, sirf Hazrat Isa (A.S) aur Hazrat Maryam (A.S) bach rahenge, agar yeh bhi apni ibadat se khush hote toh yeh bhi Jahannam mein dakhil kar diye jaate. (Ibn-e-Abi Hatim) Pahar apni jagah se tal jayenge aur benam-o-nishan ho jayenge, zameen chatyal aur hamwar maidan reh jayegi, untniyan bekar chhor di jayengi, na un ki koi nigrani karega na charaye chugaye ga na doodh nikale ga na sawari lega. 'Ushar' jama hai 'Ushra' ki, jo hamila untni daswein mahine mein lag jaye use 'Ushra' kehte hain. Matlab yeh hai ke ghabrahat aur bad-hawasi, bechaini aur pareshani is qadar hogi ke behtar se behtar maal ki bhi parwah na rahegi. Qayamat ki in balaon ne dil ura diya hoga, kaleje munh ko aayenge. Baaz log kehte hain ke yeh Qayamat ke din hoga aur logon ko is se kuch sarokar na hoga, haan un ke dekhne mein yeh hoga. Is qaul ke qail 'Ushar' ke kayi ma'ani bayan karte hain; ek toh yeh kehte hain is se murad badal hain jo duniya ki barbadi ki wajah se aasman-o-zameen ke darmiyan phirte phirenge, baaz kehte hain is se murad woh zameen hai jis ka ushar diya jata hai, baaz kehte hain is se murad ghar hain jo pehle abad the ab viran hain. Doosre saal wahan ek sau oont le kar aaye aur kehne lage Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) yeh meri qaum ka sadqa hai jo is ke badle hai jo main ne musalmanon ke sath kiya.

Hazrat Ali (R.A) farmate hain hum un oonton ko le jate thay aur un ka qaisiya rakh chora tha. Phir irshad hai ke nama-e-aamal bantay jayenge kisi ke dahne hath mein aur kisi ke bayen hath mein, aye Ibn-e-Adam tu likhwa raha hai jo lapet kar phaila kar tujhe diya jayega dekh le ke kya likhwa ke laya hai. Aasman ghaseet liya jayega aur khench liya jayega aur sameet liya jayega aur barbad ho jayega. Jahannam bharkayi jayegi Allah ke ghazab aur Bani Adam ke gunahon se uski aag tez ho jayegi. Jannat jannatiyon ke paas aa jayegi. Jab yeh tamam kaam ho chukenge us waqt har shakhs jaan lega ke usne apni duniya ki zindagi mein kya kuch aamal kiye thay, woh sab amal uske samne majood honge. Jaise aur jagah hai aayat (Yauma tajidu kullu nafsim ma amilat min khairim muhdara) (Surah Aal-e-Imran: 30). Jis din har shakhs apne kiye hue aamal ko pa lega, nek hain to samne dekh lega aur bad hain to us din woh aarzoo karega ke kaash! Uske aur uske darmiyan bahut doori hoti. Aur jagah hai aayat (Yunabba-ul-insanu yauma-izin bima qaddama wa akhkhar) (Surah Al-Qiyamah: 13). Us din insaan ko uske tamam agle pichle aamal se tanbeeh ki jayegi. Hazrat Umar (R.A) is soorat ko sunte rahe aur isko sunte hi farmaya agli tamam baatein isi liye bayan hui thin.

Ya'ni suraj benoor ho jayega, jata rahega, oondha kar ke lapet kar zameen par phenk diya jayega. Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) farmate hain suraj, chand aur sitaron ko lapet kar benoor kar ke samundaron mein daal diya jayega aur phir maghribi hawayein chalengi aur aag lag jayegi. Ek marfoo hadith mein hai ke is ko teh kar ke jahannam mein daal diya jayega (Ibn-e-Abi Hatim). Aur ek hadith mein suraj ke sath chand ka zikr bhi hai lekin woh za'eef hai. Sahih Bukhari mein yeh hadith alfaaz ki tabdeeli se marwi hai, is mein hai ke suraj aur chand qayamat ke din lapet liye jayenge. Imam Bukhari (R.H) ise Kitab-e-Bad-ul-Khalq mein laye hain lekin yahan lana zyada munasib tha ya mutabiq-e-aadat wahan aur yahan dono jagah late jaise ke Imam sahab ki aadat hai. Hazrat Abu Hurairah (R.A) ne jab yeh hadith bayan ki ke qayamat ke din yeh hoga, to Hazrat Hasan (R.H) kehne lage in ka kya gunah hai? Farmaya main ne hadith kahi aur tum is par baatein banate ho. Suraj ki qayamat wale din yeh halat hogi. Sitare sare mutaghayyar ho kar jhad jayenge jaise aur jagah hai aayat (Wa izal-kawakibu-ntatharat) (Surah Al-Infitar: 2). Yeh bhi gadle aur benoor ho kar bujh jayenge. Hazrat Ubayy bin Ka'ab (R.A) farmate hain qayamat se pehle chhe nishaniyan hongi, log apne bazaron mein honge ke achanak suraj ki roshni jati rahegi aur phir nagahan sitare toot toot kar girne lagenge, phir achanak pahad zameen par gir padenge aur zameen zor zor se jhatke lene lagegi aur betarah hilne lagegi. Bas phir kya insaan, kya jinnat, kya janwar aur kya jungli janwar sab aapas mein khalt-malt ho jayenge. Janwar bhi jo insanon se bhage phirte hain insanon ke paas aa jayenge. Logon ko is qadar bad-hawasi aur ghabrahat hogi ke behtar se behtar maal, oontiyan jo byahne waliyan hongi, un ki bhi khair-khabar na lenge. Jinnat kahenge ke hum jate hain ke tehqeeq karein kya ho raha hai lekin woh aayenge to dekhenge ke samundaron mein bhi aag lag rahi hai. Isi haal mein ek dam zameen phatne lagegi aur aasman bhi tootne lagenge, saaton zameenein aur saaton aasmanon ka yahi haal hoga. Udhar se ek tund hawa chalegi jis se tamam jaandar mar jayenge.

(Ibn-e-Abi Hatim waghera) ek aur riwayat mein hai Rasool Allah (ﷺ) farmate hain ke saare sitare aur jin jin ki Allah ke siwa ibadat ki gayi hai sab Jahannam mein gira diye jayenge, sirf Hazrat Isa (A.S) aur Hazrat Maryam (A.S) bach rahenge, agar yeh bhi apni ibadat se khush hote toh yeh bhi Jahannam mein dakhil kar diye jaate. (Ibn-e-Abi Hatim) Pahar apni jagah se tal jayenge aur benam-o-nishan ho jayenge, zameen chatyal aur hamwar maidan reh jayegi, untniyan bekar chhor di jayengi, na un ki koi nigrani karega na charaye chugaye ga na doodh nikale ga na sawari lega. 'Ushar' jama hai 'Ushra' ki, jo hamila untni daswein mahine mein lag jaye use 'Ushra' kehte hain. Matlab yeh hai ke ghabrahat aur bad-hawasi, bechaini aur pareshani is qadar hogi ke behtar se behtar maal ki bhi parwah na rahegi. Qayamat ki in balaon ne dil ura diya hoga, kaleje munh ko aayenge. Baaz log kehte hain ke yeh Qayamat ke din hoga aur logon ko is se kuch sarokar na hoga, haan un ke dekhne mein yeh hoga. Is qaul ke qail 'Ushar' ke kayi ma'ani bayan karte hain; ek toh yeh kehte hain is se murad badal hain jo duniya ki barbadi ki wajah se aasman-o-zameen ke darmiyan phirte phirenge, baaz kehte hain is se murad woh zameen hai jis ka ushar diya jata hai, baaz kehte hain is se murad ghar hain jo pehle abad the ab viran hain. Imam Qurtubi in aqwal ko bayan kar ke tarjeeh isi ko dete hain ke murad is se untniyan hain aur aksar mufassireen ka yahi qaul hai aur main toh yahi kehta hoon ke salaf se aur aimma se is ke siwa kuch warid hi nahin hua, Wallahu A'lam. Aur wahshi janwar jama kiye jayenge, jaise farman hai ayat (Wa ma min dabbatin fil-ardi wa la ta'irin yatiru bijanahihi illa umamun amthalukum) (6. Al-An'am: 38), yani zameen par chalne wale kul janwar aur hawa mein urne wale kul parind bhi tumhari tarah giroh hain, hum ne apni kitab mein koi cheez nahin chhori, phir yeh sab apne Rab ki taraf jama kiye jayenge. Sab jandaron ka hashr usi ke paas hoga yahan tak ke makkhiyan bhi, in sab mein Allah Ta'ala insaf ke sath faisle karega. In janwaron ka hashr un ki maut hi hai, albatta jin-o-ins Allah ke samne khare kiye jayenge aur un se hisab-kitab hoga. Rabi bin Khusaim ne kaha murad wahshiyon ke hashr se un par Allah ka amr aana hai, lekin Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) ne yeh sun kar farmaya ke is se murad maut hai. Yeh tamam janwar bhi ek dusre ke sath aur insanon ke sath ho jayenge, khud Quran mein aur jagah hai ayat (Wat-taira mahshurah, kullul lahu awwab) (38. Sad: 19), parind jama kiye hue, pas theek matlab is ayat ka bhi yahi hai ke wahshi janwar jama kiye jayenge. Hazrat Ali (R.A) ne ek Yahudi se poocha Jahannam kahan hai? Us ne kaha samundar mein, aap ne farmaya mere khayal mein yeh sacha hai, Quran kehta hai ayat (Wal-bahril masjur) (52. At-Tur: 6) aur farmata hai ayat (Wa izal-biharu sujjirat) (81. At-Takwir: 6).

(At-Takwir: 6) Ibn-e-Abbas R.A waghera farmate hain Allah Ta'ala maghribi hawayein bhejega woh isay bharka dengi aur sholay marti hui aag ban jayega. Ayat (Wa iza-l-biharu sujjirat) (81. At-Takwir: 6) ki tafsir mein is ka mufassal bayan guzar chuka hai. Hazrat Muawiyah bin Saeed R.H farmate hain bahr-e-room mein barkat hai, yeh zameen ke darmiyan mein hai, sab nahrein is mein girti hain aur bahr-e-kabeer bhi is mein parta hai, is ke neechay kunwein hain jin ke munh tanba se band kiye hue hain, qayam ke din woh sulag uthenge. Yeh asar ajeeb hai aur sath hi ghareeb bhi hai. Haan Abu Dawood mein ek hadith hai ke samundar ka safar sirf haaji karein aur umrah karne wale ya jihad karne wale ghazi, is liye ke samundar ke neechay aag hai aur aag ke neechay pani hai. Is ka bayan bhi Surah Fatir ki tafsir mein guzar chuka hai. Sujjirat ke ma'ani yeh bhi kiye gaye hain ke khushk kar diya jayega, ek qatra bhi baqi na rahega. Yeh ma'ani bhi kiye gaye hain ke baha diya jayega aur idhar udhar beh niklega. Phir farmata hai ke har qisam ke log yakja jama kar diye jayenge, jaise aur jagah hai ayat (Ushuru-l-lazina zalamu wa azwajahum wa ma kanu ya'budun) (37. As-Saffat: 22) zalimon ko aur un ke joron yani un jaison ko jama karo. Hadith mein hai har shakhs ka us qoum ke sath hashr kiya jayega jo is jaise a'maal karti ho. Allah Ta'ala farmata hai ayat (Wa kuntum azwajan salasa) (56. Al-Waqi'ah: 7) tum teen tarah ke giroh ho jaoge, kuch woh jin ke dahne hath mein namah-e-a'maal honge, kuch bayen hath wale, kuch sabqat karne wale. Ibn-e-Abi Hatim mein hai ke Hazrat Umar bin Khattab R.A ne khutba parhte hue is ayat ki tilawat ki aur farmaya har jama'at apne jaison se mil jayegi. Dusri riwayat mein hai ke woh do shakhs jin ke amal ek jaise hon woh ya to jannat mein sath rahenge ya jahannam mein sath jalenge. Hazrat Umar R.A se is ayat ki tafsir puchi gayi to farmaya nek nekon ke sath mil jayenge aur bad badon ke sath aag mein. Hazrat Farooq-e-Azam R.A ne ek martaba logon se is ayat ki tafsir puchi to sab khamosh rahe, aap ne farmaya lo main bataun, aadmi ka jora jannat mein isi jaisa hoga isi tarah jahannam mein bhi. Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas R.A farmate hain matlab is se yahi hai ke teen qisam ke log ho jayenge yani Ashab-e-Yameen, Ashab-e-Shimal aur Sabiqeen. Mujahid R.H farmate hain har qisam ke log ek sath honge, yahi qaul Imam Ibn-e-Jareer R.H bhi pasand karte hain aur yahi theek bhi hai. Dusra qaul yeh hai ke Arsh ke paas se pani ka ek darya jaari hoga jo chalis saal tak behta rahega aur bari numaya choran mein hoga, is se tamam mare saray galay ugnay lagenge, is tarah ke ho jayenge ke jo unhein pehchanta ho woh agar unhein ab dekh le to ba-yak nigah pehchan le, phir ruhein chhori jayengi aur har rooh apne jism mein aa jayegi, yahi ma'ani hain ayat (Wa iza-n-nufusu zuwwijat).

(At-Takwir: 7) Ya'ni roohein jismon mein mila di jayengi aur yeh ma'ni bhi bayan kiye gaye hain ke mominon ka jora hooron se lagaya jayega aur kafiron ka shaitanon se (Tazkirah Qurtubi). Phir irshad hota hai ayat (Wa izal-mau'udatu su'ilat) (81. At-Takwir: 8). Jamhoor ki qira'at yahi hai. Ahl-e-Jahiliyat ladkiyon ko napasand karte thay aur unhein zinda dargor (zinda dafan) kardiya karte thay. Un se Qayamat ke din sawal hoga ke yeh kyun qatl ki gayin? Taake un ke qatilon ko zyada daant-dupat aur sharmindagi ho aur yeh bhi samajh lijiye ke jab mazloom se sawal hua to zalim ka to kehna hi kya hai? Aur yeh bhi kaha gaya hai ke woh khud poochengi ke unhein kis bina par zinda dargor kiya gaya? Is ke mutaliq ahadees suniye. Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hai Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain: Main ne qasd kiya ke logon ko halat-e-hamal ki mujama'at se rok doon lekin main ne dekha ke Roomi aur Farsi yeh kaam karte hain aur un ki aulad ko is se kuch nuqsan nahin pahunchta. Logon ne aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se azl ke bare mein sawal kiya ya'ni bar-waqt nutfa ko bahar daal dene ke bare mein to aap ne farmaya ke yeh dar-parda zinda gaar dena hai aur isi ka bayan "Wa izal-mau'udatu" al-kh mein hai. Salma bin Yazeed aur un ke bhai sarkar-e-nabuwwat mein hazir ho kar sawal karte hain ke hamari maa ameer-zadi thin, woh sila-rehmi karti thin, mehman-nawazi karti thin aur bhi nek kaam bahut kuch karti thin lekin jahiliyat mein hi mar gayi hain to kya us ke yeh nek kaam use kuch nafa denge? Aap ne farmaya nahin. Unhon ne kaha ke us ne hamari ek behen ko zinda dafan kardiya hai kya woh bhi use kuch nafa degi? Aap ne farmaya zinda gaadi hui aur zinda gaadne wali jahannam mein hain, haan yeh aur baat hai ke woh Islam ko qabool karle (Musnad-e-Ahmad). Ibn-e-Abi Hatim mein hai zinda dafan karne wali aur jise dafan kiya hai dono jahannam mein hain. Ek Sahabiya (R.A) ke sawal par ke Jannat mein kaun jayega? Aap ne farmaya Nabi, shaheed, bachay aur zinda dargor ki hui. Yeh hadees mursal hai Hazrat Hasan se jise ba'az muhaddiseen ne qabooliyat ka martaba diya hai. Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas farmate hain ke mushrikon ke chhoti umar mein mare hue bachay jannati hain, jo unhein jahannami kahe woh jhoota hai. Allah Ta'ala farmata hai (Wa izal-mau'udatu su'ilat) (81. At-Takwir: 8) (Ibn-e-Abi Hatim). Qais bin Asim (R.A) sawal karte hain ke Ya Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) main ne jahiliyat ke zamane mein apni bachiyon ko zinda daba diya hai main kya karoon? Aap ne farmaya har ek ke badle ek ghulam azad karo. Unhon ne kaha Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ghulam wala to main hoon nahin albata mere paas oont hain.
